high_level_description: The image depicts a group of people lying on the floor in what appears to be a dimly lit room with a modern, minimalist design. The room has a high ceiling with exposed beams, and the walls are covered with dark curtains that partially obscure the view of the room beyond. The lighting is subdued, creating a calm and intimate atmosphere. There are several individuals scattered across the floor, each lying on their backs or sides, some with their heads resting on orange cushions. They appear relaxed and possibly engaged in a form of meditation or restorative activity.
